title: Insurers pivot AI strategy toward core risk underwriting
summary: Insurance companies are shifting their AI investments from experimental projects to core business functions, particularly in risk underwriting and capital allocation, as shown by the 2026 Evident AI Index findings.
problem_solved: Moving AI beyond peripheral efficiency gains to directly impact core insurance risk evaluation and financial decision-making.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the maturation of AI in insurance from hype to practical business value in critical functions like underwriting discipline and capital allocation.
